_comment: Fallback pilot-cohort fixture for db/seeds/fellowship-pilot.ts. Used when no DFL prod SELECT creds are present in env (DFL_SUPABASE_URL + DFL_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) and/or the separate cohort-seed task has not populated a real cohort. Each entry maps a DFL fellow -> an Itera-local learner under the `dfl-batch` tenant. `dfl_subject` is the DFL auth.users.id (opaque, ADR-4 — NOT an FK). The first entry is the CLAUDE_SMOKE_* e2e user (N>=1 guarantee). Placeholder fellows have synthetic dfl_subjects (uuid v4) and are safe no-ops if re-seeded.

fellows.note: CLAUDE_SMOKE_* e2e user. dfl_subject is a placeholder until the real DFL auth uid is resolved via env creds; the email is the join key so re-seeding with the real uid is idempotent on (email).
